title: A daily catalog shard on a test machine runs a case that imports a project dependency, and it passes
description: On a test install with a ready test machine, a catalog shard placed there runs Mainworks' own E2E runner over the project's installed packages, so a case importing a project dependency passes, and a shard that cannot resolve a module names the missing specifier in the filed failure.

steps.name: run a dependency-importing case in a catalog shard on a test machine
